# automox_worklets (Data Source)

The Automox Worklet Catalogue — community and Automox-authored worklets available to this organization.

These are catalogue entries, not policies in your organization; use `automox_policies` with `policy_type = "custom"` for those.

Worklet source code is not returned by this endpoint, so none is written to state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Only worklets in this category, such as `Security`.
- `os_family` (String) Only worklets for this OS family.
- `query` (String) Full-text search across the catalogue.

### Read-Only

- `worklets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--worklets))

<a id="nestedatt--worklets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `worklets`

Read-Only:

- `access` (String) `free` or `premium`.
- `categories` (List of String)
- `create_time` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type` (List of String) `SERVER`, `WORKSTATION`, or both.
- `keywords` (List of String)
- `language` (String) Scripting language, such as `PowerShell` or `Bash`.
- `license_required` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `os_family` (String) `Windows`, `Mac`, or `Linux`.
- `update_time` (String)
- `uuid` (String)
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether Automox has verified this worklet.
- `version` (String)
